patch_description:
This version replaces the single-style differential evolution loop with a hybrid maximin search designed around the active constraints: the smallest triangle triples currently limiting each layout. It combines broad differential proposals, sparse Gaussian exploration, and targeted late-stage mutations focused on points that occur most frequently in the worst-area triples.

The search also uses better spread-out simplex seeds, elite restarts, exact simplex projection, and a final deterministic active-set pattern search. This directly addresses the nonsmooth bottleneck of the Heilbronn objective rather than treating all coordinates equally throughout optimization.
